annotations.title: Read unit options for a roster

description: Lists what each named unit lets a roster pick set, with names first and the ids a pick takes beside them: its sizes, its toggles (key of the Warlord toggle: set toggles {key: 1} on exactly one CHARACTER), and every choice group (wargear, enhancement, detachment upgrade, unit composition) with its options' ids, points, how many the default loadout takes (taken), and per-option min and max. A choice whose set is choices takes {key: optionId}; omit an optional one to decline it. One whose set is spreads takes {key: {optionId: count}}, counts within each option's min and max, totalling no more than room and at least least; for 'every model one option' give the whole room to one option. A group whose key extends another's key and option id applies only while that option is taken. Enhancements and detachment upgrades appear only with a detachment, at their cost; a list takes each enhancement once, on a CHARACTER that is not an Epic Hero. roster gives the catalogueId, detachmentIds and dispositions a save_roster or check_roster roster takes. Leave out a choice to keep the default; check the finished list with check_roster.

detachment.description: Detachment id, slug, or name from list_units; enhancements and detachment upgrades are offered only under one.

faction.description: Faction id, URL slug, or display name from list_reference or list_units.

units.description: The units to read options for, priced together as one list in this battle size and detachment.

models.description: Unit size; per-model limits depend on it. Defaults to the minimum size.

unit.description: Unit id, slug, or name from list_units.

name: get_unit_options
title: Read unit options for a roster
